correctness.rationale: For the full labelled m-by-n grid, T outputs precisely the union of the monochromatic lines. A cross with both supports proper and nonempty has exactly those monochromatic lines, while an empty or full support gives W on the next application. The parity matrix proves exact two-round sharpness for every m,n>=2. The proper terminal crosses have recoverable supports. In each proper basin, all selected lines agree on one bit at their intersections; each residual line must contain its complement. Inclusion–exclusion for zero residual lines gives 2H(m-r,n-c), including one-row or one-column residuals, and subtraction gives the W basin. A 2-by-2 check gives four basins of size two and a W basin of size eight. For independent unbiased bits on the square, a monochromatic row–column pair has probability 2^(2-2N); pair overlaps share respectively 3N-2 or 4N-4 forced cells, all of one bit. The summed pair intersections are lower order, and only the two constant matrices must be removed from the union. These arguments prove the general assertions independently of the bundled finite enumeration; verify.py was inspected, not executed.
